preservation_certificate.proof_artifact: PROOF_MAP.md and lean/H116FiberTrace.lean; a full finite certificate and an eleven-coefficient quotient/ten-coefficient curve-identity certificate each imply the recurrence. The Lean cutoff proves X^(p-1) is invisible below degree 22 for prime p>19. Against Mathlib's actual FormalGroup, Lean now proves Y divides F(X,Y)-X, an X^m correction preserves the prefix below m, and the leading-X double-pole bridge loses exactly one degree. The generic prefix-transfer lemmas preserve unit inverse squares and a regular outer unit; PREFIX_TRANSFER_EXPERIMENT.md measures that the pole loss is sharp in 20 finite-field controls and REGULAR_SUBSTITUTION_EXPERIMENT.md verifies all three composition boundaries in 20 further cases. The curve-coordinate instance identifies the outer unit by q=1+A X^4q^2+B X^6q^3, proves the cleared affine identity, target rescaling and complete normalized x-ratio prefix; CURVE_COORDINATE_EXPERIMENT.md checks the corresponding 24-coefficient formulas on five curves and identity certificate IDC1h692b3e04c6a4f0cd seals the rescaling polynomial. The additive-endomorphism specialization derives V+pi=[t] from pointwise injectivity, pi*V=[p], and the characteristic equation; a ZMod 2 mutation proves injectivity is a necessary boundary. The affine-point instance constructs pi from Mathlib's finite-field Frobenius, inherits additivity and injectivity, and proves the exact (x^p,y^p) coordinate action over ZMod p. Over algebraic extensions the inverse Frobenius point map now defines V=[p]*piInverse and proves pi*V=[p]; Lean rearranges the resulting sum identity to V-1=[t-1]-pi, proves equality after the actual affine-point observable z=-x/y, and supplies a generating-set certificate interface with trace fixed to p+1-Nat.card E(F_p). It also proves that every algebraic affine point lies in a positive Frobenius-fixed locus and that characteristic checks on every such locus imply the global pointwise V-1 identity; a ZMod 3 control shows one locus is insufficient. The restricted characteristic family and rational/scheme/local-series identification remain explicit. FROBENIUS_BOUNDARY_EXPERIMENT.md records the preregistered p=31 first difference 15 and delta 10 with two map identities and three rejected controls. MAP_CERTIFICATE_EXPERIMENT.md, JET_CERTIFICATE_EXPERIMENT.md, FORMAL_SCALAR_JET_EXPERIMENT.md and FORMAL_SCALAR_OOS_EXPERIMENT.md record independently replayed excluded-map controls
